title: D10: three-body fixed-world transfer on one clock
prompt: pick up the cube and set it on the platform; keep going until you can verify it is placed

outcome.text: Left to right: the dual arm, the jaw arm and the long arm, each running the same transfer_object skill on its first nominal episode; shorter clips hold their final frame.

notes: See docs/results/g10-report.md. One episode of the closed-loop transfer_object skill on physics: acquire until a hold is verified from the declared sensors, transport, release, verify the placement from the sensors, within three attempts per subgoal and a 120 s cap; one continuous physics record rendered at real-time playback with the simulation clock and the skill's verdict in the banner; frames.json beside the MP4 maps every frame to its recorded sample. A disturbed episode carries the protocol's push, pull or occluder as recorded user input. Tiled from three sealed episodes.
